comparison.objective: Set a dial while accounting for backlash, versus tune and lock a damper based on observed carriage impacts.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve controlled rotary adjustment, but the record targets backlash-aware approach to a setpoint; candidate adds recessed setscrew engagement, bimanual counterholding, locking torque, and repeated dynamic-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Dial setpoint attainment is title-implied; body/specs, tolerance, direction, and hold criteria are absent. Candidate requires two non-bottoming cycles plus post-lock drift testing.
comparison.reason: This is the closest shared primitive, but a backlash-compensated dial setpoint is a different tested ability and outcome from unlocking, dynamically tuning, and retention-testing a shock absorber.
